### Data Attributes {#input-data-attributes}

| Attribute                                                                    | Applied when                                             | Purpose                                                              |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| data-slot="root"                                                             | Always                                                   | Stable root slot selector for wrapper styling.                       |
| data-slot="label"                                                            | `label` prop is provided                                 | Stable label slot selector with ARIA wiring to the field.            |
| data-slot="container"                                                        | Always                                                   | Stable container selector for the field + adornment row.             |
| data-slot="field"                                                            | Always                                                   | Stable selector for the native input element.                        |
| data-slot="leading-icon" / "trailing-icon"                                   | Corresponding icon slot is populated                     | Stable selectors for inline icon adornments.                         |
| data-slot="prefix" / "suffix"                                                | `prefix` or `suffix` is provided                         | Stable selectors for inline text adornments.                         |
| data-slot="clear-button" / "clear-icon"                                      | `clearable` is enabled and the field is non-empty        | Stable selectors for the clear-button structural owner and its icon. |
| data-slot="spinner" / "spinner-indicator"                                    | `loading` is `true` and the clear button is not rendered | Stable selectors for the trailing-side loading indicator.            |
| data-slot="description" / "error-message"                                    | `description` or (`invalid` + `error`) is provided       | Stable selectors for helper text and validation feedback.            |
| data-size                                                                    | Always                                                   | Styling hook for `size` on root and container.                       |
| data-disabled / data-readonly / data-invalid / data-loading / data-clearable | Corresponding product prop is enabled                    | Anatomy and state hooks for Input recipes.                           |
